text: User friendly interface. Groww is an excellent trading and investment app, especially for beginners as well as experienced investors. The app interface is extremely clean, simple, and user-friendly, making investing stress-free. Opening an account is quick, and everything from stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, IPOs, and F&O is available on one platform.What I really like is the transparent pricing with zero AMC, fast order execution, and detailed stock & mutual fund information that helps in making informed decisions. The app runs smoothly without lag, and fund transfer & withdrawals are quick and hassle-free.Customer support is responsive, and regular updates keep improving the experience. Overall, Groww has made investing easy, safe, and convenient. Highly recommended for anyone serious about growing their wealth 📈

Very handy and safe app. I would like to sincerely appreciate the vision and efforts of the founders behind this app. It truly feels like a complete package under one roof—bringing together knowledge, assistance, and practical solutions in such a seamless and user-friendly way.Whether it’s professional drafting, quick information, or day-to-day guidance, the platform consistently delivers with accuracy and efficiency. It saves time, reduces effort, and enhances productivity, making it an invaluable companion in both personal and professional life.Kudos to the entire team for creating such a powerful and reliable tool. Your innovation is genuinely making a difference!

Dont trade on this app so many glitches while trading you will loose your captial for sure. I am writing to express my extreme disappointment with the repeated glitches and technical failures on the Groww app.Today was the final straw. A trading platform should be reliable, especially during market hours when every second matters. Instead, I have repeatedly experienced issues that have affected my trading experience and confidence in your platform.It is incredibly frustrating to trust an app with my hard-earned money only to face technical glitches when reliability matters the most. These recurring problems have caused unnecessary stress and have made trading through Groww an unpleasant experience.Because of these repeated failures, I have decided to withdraw my trading journey from Groww. This has been, without a doubt, the worst trading platform experience I have ever had. I expected stability and professionalism, but instead I encountered glitches and poor reliability.I request that you investigate these issues seriously. No trader should have to suffer losses, anxiety, or missed opportunities because of platform failures.I will be moving my trading activities elsewhere. I hope you take customer complaints like this seriously and improve your platform for those who continue to use it.Extremely disappointed,

Excellent app for investing! Groww is extremely easy to use, even for someone who doesn’t have much expertise in investing. The interface is simple, clean and intuitive, making it easy to understand and manage investments.The dashboard is particularly useful—it gives a quick and clear overview of investments, returns and portfolio performance. I really appreciate how everything is organised without making the app feel complicated.Overall, a very user-friendly platform for both beginners and experienced investors. Highly recommended!

I first started my stock investment and SIP in this app only from 2023. I began my stock market investment journey and SIPs with the Groww trading app in 2023, and it has been a great experience so far. As a beginner, I found the app extremely user-friendly and easy to understand. The clean interface, simple navigation, and clear explanations made investing feel less intimidating.Starting SIPs and investing in stocks was smooth, and tracking my portfolio has been very convenient. Over time, I have been able to accumulate funds consistently, and I’m really happy to see that my investments are growing steadily. The app provides helpful insights and updates that keep me informed about my investments.Overall, Groww is a reliable and beginner-friendly app for anyone who wants to start their investment journey with confidence. I’m satisfied with my experience and happy with the progress of my funds.

App loading time is crazy high - very bad UX. Groww app has been terrible off late. Takes almost a minute to open up, user is supposed to wait ages to just open the app? Tried sending in app feedback reports multiple time about the same in hopes that it might be fixed, but sadly no one has looked at it. It has only gotten more slower if anything. Takes too long to open the app (it's stuck on the loading spinner while opening the app), and once app opens there's another spinner on each of stocks and mutual fund screen which again takes good 10-15 sec to load the initial home screen data. This is too long and not acceptable at all, extremely unresponsive app. Been a happy Groww user since very long, app never had this issue - only seems to be an issue since the past few months (dont remember precisely). Will switch to some other app if this is not fixed asap, such insane app loading times are totally unacceptable.

Account frozen, useless support, cost me thousands. I have been locked out of my own investments due to a "ReKYC" process that the app explicitly claims takes "1-2 days." It has now been well over a week, and my account is still completely frozen with a systemic error stating onboarding is not allowed.Because Groww restricted my account, I was prevented from executing a time-sensitive sell order on August 28th. I urgently requested their support chat to manually execute the trade on my behalf to prevent a financial hit, but I was completely ignored. As a direct result of this operational failure and their account lock, my position dropped, and I suffered a direct loss of ₹4,000 in profits that I was actively trying to book.The customer service is abysmal. The escalation team operates in a continuous loop, closing out my tickets with automated, copy-pasted templates stating the issue is "prioritized" and "forwarded to the concerned team," yet the account remains blocked and the issue is never actually resolved.If you want a reliable broker where you can actually access your portfolio and sell your shares during crucial market moments, look elsewhere. Groww's system delays and completely unresponsive support will literally cost you money.Highly disappointing experience.

3rd CLASS TRADING APP. Extremely disappointing trading experience. My order was clearly in profit, but when I tried to exit, the order failed or did not execute properly multiple times. I attempted to exit 2–3 times, but by the time the order finally went through, the position had moved into a loss.This is a serious issue for a trading platform. In fast-moving markets, even a few seconds can make a huge difference. Traders should not have to repeatedly attempt an exit while their position is already in profit.The overall experience was frustrating and unreliable. Groww seriously needs to improve order execution, stability, and reliability during market hours. I expected much better from a platform used for trading.

Not good enough.. If you want to lose your money, download this app. I am facing serious issues while trading on the Groww platform.Whenever I place an order at the price currently displayed on the app, or set a specific price at which I want to buy or sell, my order is often not executed at the expected price or within the expected time.I am also experiencing problems with stop-loss orders. Even after setting a specific stop-loss level, my position sometimes gets executed at a different price, resulting in a higher loss than I expected.There also appears to be a delay in order execution. Even when the market reaches the price at which my order should be triggered, the order is not always executed immediately. This has caused me financial losses on multiple occasions.I request you to investigate the following:1. Why are my orders not being executed promptly when the market reaches my specified price?2. Why are my stop-loss orders sometimes executed at a price different from the stop-loss level I set?3. Is there any execution delay, slippage, liquidity issue, or other technical reason responsible for these differences?4. Please provide the complete order execution details for the affected trades, including the order placement time, trigger time, execution time, requested price, and actual executed price.I request a proper investigation and a clear explanation regarding these issues, as they are directly affecting my trades and causing financial losses.Please resolve this issue at the earliest.

Absolutely Disappointing Experience with Groww. Absolutely the worst experience I’ve had with a financial app. I started using Groww for mutual fund investments and later took a personal loan. Due to a job loss, I unfortunately missed one EMI, despite having paid the others on time.What followed was extremely disappointing. Within just two days, I received repeated calls from their customer-care/collection team, including questions about my location. I found the way this was handled extremely disrespectful and stressful.I would strongly suggest users think carefully before taking loans through this platform. My experience with their loan recovery process has completely changed my view of the company.

Uses Cheap tricks to devour your money. I recently bought two lots of crude oil expiry contract at 309 and 314 respectively which I sold(both lots) at 324. Which costed me a stunning amount of Rs 3060 as a transaction charge. When asked about this error, groww team replied and showed a contract note displaying that I bought two lots and sold only one at above price. So, where did the other lot go? I exited the trade in a single go so that means I exited bot of them, I even checked twice whether I exited that trade and I did. It costed me Rs3060 for a trade which was errored from their end. Requested a call back, which obviously didn’t receive. There’s no way to ask for that amount I paid for no reason. I’ve had numerous encounters where profit shown and received were extremely different. These are just outrageous ways to fool people to get their money entangled in intrinsic and complicated systems. This is digital extortion. Respond and refund team Groww.

One of the most pathetic experiences I have ever had with a financial platform. Groww looks impressive until you actually need help. The moment there is a serious issue involving your money, the so-called “customer support” becomes an endless cycle of useless automated replies, copy-pasted messages and absolutely zero accountability.It is honestly frustrating to see a financial platform put so much effort into making the app look smooth while seemingly putting so little effort into actually helping customers when something goes wrong.You don’t feel like a customer—you feel like a ticket number being passed around by a system that doesn’t care whether your problem gets resolved or not.When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service.The entire experience has been unbelievably frustrating, time-consuming and disappointing. If you expect quick resolution, proper communication and someone to actually take ownership of your issue, don’t expect much from Groww.I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved.Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience.I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.

Very good experience. I have been a Groww customer since past more than 5 years and I am very satisfied with Groww - wonderful interface, ease of use, prompt support. Recently I saw that Groww has introduced global investing through US stocks and US based ETFs. This is a good option for global diversification considering investment through mutual fund route is almost closed since early 2022.It was my suggestion to Groww’s team to introduce UCITS ETF (ETFs which are not US based) since this would avoid high withholding tax on dividend as well as Estate tax imposed by US. Also, dividends of UCITS are reinvested automatically inside the Fund. Platforms such as IndMoney do offer UCITS ETF. Since Groww is a very progressive organisation and takes pride in always keeping its ears to the ground and giving customer satisfaction highest importance, I hope Groww team takes note of this suggestion.
